summary: 10 countries. The renewed US strikes on Iran are in the mix through Qatar and Türkiye, but the coverage runs wide today. Outlets are also leading on trade and the USMCA talks, a court case over destroyed evidence, US health aid cuts felt in Africa, deportations, a conductor taking over the San Francisco Symphony, padel's boom in Miami, security ties across Asia, and the mood toward America in its 250th year.
